cards.heading: 48–24 Hours Before Your Appointment: Simple Prep Steps
title: How to Prepare for
IV Therapy
cards.alt: Prepare for IV therapy: hydrate, eat a light meal, skip alcohol, bring a medication list, wear loose sleeves

items.label: Hydrate
items.note: Water the day before and that morning

items.label: Light meal
items.note: Protein and complex carbs, 1 to 2 hours before

items.label: Loose sleeves
items.note: Rolled above the elbow, plus a layer

title: Your First
IV Therapy
Appointment
cards.alt: An IV therapy appointment: history and consent, vitals and vein check, then the drip with a clinician monitoring

steps.label: Vitals
steps.note: Blood pressure, heart rate, vein assessment

steps.label: The drip
steps.note: Coolness in the arm is normal, say if anything is not

cards.subject: IV therapy
cards.heading: Aftercare: Getting the Most from Your Drip
title: After Your
IV Therapy
Drip
cards.alt: IV therapy aftercare: keep sipping water, keep activity gentle, remove the bandage after 30 minutes

items.label: Keep sipping
items.note: Water, plus a balanced meal within a few hours

items.label: Go gently
items.note: Save hard training for when you feel normal

items.label: Bandage off
items.note: Leave it 15 to 30 minutes, then remove

items.label: Call us if
items.note: Redness, swelling or pain at the site increases
